info.title: Focacal
info.description: AI-powered calendar focus scheduler. Read your calendar, query focus blocks, trigger replanning, and manage your schedule.

get.description: Returns all real calendar events and AI-planned blocks for today sorted by start time.

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. America/New_York). Defaults to UTC.

200.description: List of events and blocks for today

get.summary: Get the current or next event
get.description: Returns the event or block that is active right now. If nothing is active, returns the next upcoming item. Returns null if the day is empty.

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: IANA timezone name. Defaults to UTC.

200.description: Current or next event, or null

get.description: Returns synced calendar events (not AI blocks) for a date range.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Range start in RFC 3339. Defaults to start of today.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Range end in RFC 3339. Defaults to 14 days from now.

get.description: Returns focus, lunch, and break blocks planned by the AI for a date range.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Range start in RFC 3339. Defaults to start of today.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Range end in RFC 3339. Defaults to 14 days from now.

post.description: Creates a user-defined block. Always locked — the AI will not move or delete it on the next replan.

patch.description: Update a block's end time, title, or locked status.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Block ID (as returned in the id field, e.g. focacal-block-{uuid})

delete.description: Permanently removes a block. Locked blocks can be deleted here (this endpoint always succeeds regardless of lock status).

post.description: Asks the AI agent to regenerate the focus schedule for the next 7 days based on current calendar events.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Config domain. app: server, auth.enabled (config.yaml). planner: working_hours, lunch, focus, colors, agent (planner.yaml). calendars: accounts, calendars, destinations, oauth (calendars.yaml).

get.description: Returns the saved values of one domain (file contents over defaults; environment overrides are not applied). Secrets (password, url, api_key) are never returned; accounts and calendars carry has_secret instead.

500.description: A config file on disk could not be read, parsed or written; details are in the server log

503.description: The config service is not available on this server

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: When true, run everything except the write and return the view the patch would produce, with pruned listing what a delete would remove. The file is not touched.

patch.description: Applies an RFC 7396 JSON merge patch to the domain's file. Send only what changes; null deletes a key or a collection item. Collections (accounts, calendars, destinations) are objects keyed by item id; ids are immutable (an item id that differs from its key is rejected, rename through name). Ids of new items must match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$, so prefer POST /config/calendars/{collection}, which generates the id from name. Deleting an account or calendar also deletes the calendars of a deleted account, the destinations that target a deleted calendar and the inputs that name one, all in the same write; hand-edited dangling references elsewhere are left alone. Use dry_run=true to see what a delete would remove (the pruned list) without writing. The patched domain is validated before anything is written; on any error the file is unchanged. Changes apply live within about a second, except the server block (ports, bind address, webhooks), which needs a restart (see pending_restart). The file is rewritten on save: comments and unknown keys are not preserved. If a hand edit later fails to load, the previous config keeps running and GET reports load_error. Secrets cannot be set through the API; reference them with *_env or *_file fields. A destination's inputs is the string "all" or a list of {calendar, kinds?, event?}: kinds (focus, lunch, break) is allowed only on the built-in focacal calendar; event is optional and when absent the input is published in full, while a present event block is taken literally (title and body each {visibility, rename?}; an omitted field is hidden). Hiding title or body also hides location, meeting URL and original ids. Targets are exactly one of {calendar} or {served: true, auth: private}; auth public is not available yet. The body is limited to 1 MiB.

400.description: Malformed body: not JSON, not a JSON object, an unknown key, or a value of the wrong type

422.description: Validation failed (a bad value, a required value set to null, or an inline secret); nothing was written

500.description: A config file on disk could not be read, parsed or written; details are in the server log

503.description: The config service is not available on this server

post.summary: Create an account, calendar or destination
post.description: Adds one item to the calendars domain. Send the item without an id: name is required and the server derives the id from it (lowercase letters, digits and dashes, up to 63 characters; -2, -3 appended when taken, compared ignoring case; focacal is reserved among calendars). A body containing id is rejected. The result is validated like a PATCH and written atomically. Ids never change afterwards.

400.description: Malformed body, an id in the body, an unknown field or a value of the wrong type

422.description: Validation failed (name missing, an inline secret, a dangling reference...); nothing was written

500.description: A config file on disk could not be read, parsed or written; details are in the server log

503.description: The config service is not available on this server

get.description: Returns service status, last successful replan time, and per-source sync and webhook state.
Returns the next 14 days of events and AI blocks as a standard iCalendar (ICS) file. Subscribe in any calendar app with webcal://host:5233/calendar.ics

id.description: Composite ID. Blocks use prefix focacal-block-{uuid}

source.description: Source calendar ID, or 'focacal' for AI blocks

conference_url.description: Zoom / Meet / Teams URL if present

locked.description: Locked blocks are skipped by the AI on replan

is_now.description: True if this event is currently active

minutes_until.description: Minutes until start. Negative means already started.

values.description: Saved values keyed by top-level key (e.g. working_hours, focus). Collections are objects keyed by item id; secrets are omitted and accounts and calendars carry has_secret.

order.description: Each collection's ids in file order, since JSON objects are unordered. Empty for domains without collections.

pending_restart.description: True only when the file-level server block differs from the one the process started with (restart to apply). Other changes apply live.

load_error.description: Empty when the last reload succeeded. Otherwise why the last hand edit could not be applied; values then show the last good config, which keeps running. Never includes secrets.

pruned.description: Present when a delete removed more than the item it named (set on PATCH responses, including dry runs). kind is calendar (of a deleted account), destination (targeting a deleted calendar) or destination_input (id is <destination>/<calendar>).
